comment: Theme taxonomy for Deck Forge. 'detect' = case-insensitive regexes run against each card's oracle text (or type line where noted); a card scoring >=1 counts toward the theme. 'payoffs' = Scryfall queries for cards that reward the theme (engines and finishers), run with identity/budget/legality filters appended. Shared by decktool.py and the web UI. 'game_ending' = regex tagging a combo or finisher as table-ending; 'finishers' = named Scryfall queries for finite game-enders. Both are shared by both front-ends too.
